==Black Ajah==
I don't think the 'point' is to obscure the BA, here; I thought the point was navigation among articles. I appreciate the irony of what you're doing, but.. [[User:Nae'blis|nae'blis]] ''<sub>[[User_talk:Nae'blis|(talk)]]</sub>'' 17:45, 27 June 2006 (UTC)
: Well my point was to obscure them because they are not at all like the official ajahs and arguably don't belong in this template at all.  To me the obfuscated link seems like a tastefully amusing compromise.
: But to each his own, I guess; I'm hardly going to complain if you really want to change it back again. --[[User:Gherald|Gherald]] 23:24, 27 June 2006 (UTC)
::Indeed, I'll leave it alone unless somebody else wants to weigh in. [[User:Nae'blis|nae'blis]] ''<sub>[[User_talk:Nae'blis|(talk)]]</sub>'' 18:48, 5 July 2006 (UTC)

:I like it this way [[User:71.236.79.160|71.236.79.160]] 22:46, 20 October 2006 (UTC)

Hmm, think I have to go with [[User:Nae'blis|nae'blis]]'s initial thoughts here. While ultimately we're a fan site, and we don't have to be as straightlaced as Wikipedia, we ''are'' here to provide the reader with information as a primary goal. How about, as [[User:Gherald|Gherald]] hinted, removing the Black link from the main coloured list, and providing it in centred smalltext at the bottom of the template? [[User:Aristoc|Aristoc]] 12:19, 8 December 2006 (UTC)
